entries: **Codex quota shows fresher, more accurate numbers (#24)**: (1) the menu-bar Codex quota now updates at the very start of each refresh instead of waiting for the slower history pass; (2) SQLite and JSONL sources are merged per window (5-hour / weekly) instead of picking one whole source, so a just-hit 100% limit is no longer overwritten by an older 80% snapshot; (3) small usage shows a fractional percentage instead of rounding to 0%; (4) the refresh timer uses the configured interval instead of a hard-coded 300s; (5) FSEvents-triggered refreshes queue instead of being dropped while one is in flight; (6) if the Claude Code read fails mid-refresh, the already-loaded Codex percentage is preserved instead of flickering away.

**Stale "🆕 update available" badge no longer lingers after upgrading**: the cache cleanup previously ran only inside the update-check path, so the badge stuck until the app restarted; it now compares the installed version on every timer refresh and clears as soon as you're current.

title.zh-TW: Codex 額度顯示更精準，不再被舊資料吃掉
title.en: Codex quota updates are instantly precise and stop overwriting themselves with stale data

body.zh-TW: 你選單列上的 Codex 額度顯示現在會更新得更快也更準了。以前系統在匯整兩種不同來源的紀錄時，只要看到一份舊資料就會直接覆蓋掉剛出爐的新資料，導致你明明剛衝破 100% 額度，卻突然又倒退回 80%。現在它學會了分開核對每種額度的最新狀態，而且微小用量會精準顯示小數點，也不必再苦等歷史紀錄跑完才更新畫面。同時，系統改用可設定的重新整理間隔來取代寫死的 300 秒；檔案變動（FSEvents）觸發的重新整理現在會乖乖排隊而不是互相打斷；就算中途 Claude Code 讀取失敗，也會保留已經載入的 Codex 百分比而不是讓畫面閃一下又清空。就像你的悠遊卡原本每次感應都會被昨天搭車的舊紀錄覆蓋餘額，現在它終於學會以最新的扣款時間為準，連幾毛錢都能算得清清楚楚，而且逼卡瞬間就顯示餘額，不用再等機器跑半天。
body.en: The Codex quota shown on your menu bar is now much fresher and more accurate. Previously, when the system merged two different data sources, it could accidentally let an older snapshot overwrite a brand-new update—meaning you might hit a 100% limit only to see it jump bizarrely back down to 80%. Now, it individually tracks the latest state for each quota, displays precise fractional percentages for small usage, and updates the UI instantly without waiting for the heavier history scans to finish. It also uses your configured refresh interval instead of a hard-coded 300 seconds. File-system (FSEvents) triggered refreshes now neatly queue up instead of dropping when one is in flight, and if reading Claude Code fails mid-refresh, the already-loaded Codex percentage is safely preserved instead of flickering away. It's like your subway card suddenly forgetting your last ride and showing yesterday's balance; now it strictly respects the newest timestamp, calculates every single cent accurately, and flashes the balance the moment you tap without making you wait for the machine to grind.

items.original: **Codex quota shows fresher, more accurate numbers (#24)**: (1) the menu-bar Codex quota now updates at the very start of each refresh instead of waiting for the slower history pass; (2) SQLite and JSONL sources are merged per window (5-hour / weekly) instead of picking one whole source, so a just-hit 100% limit is no longer overwritten by an older 80% snapshot; (3) small usage shows a fractional percentage instead of rounding to 0%; (4) the refresh timer uses the configured interval instead of a hard-coded 300s; (5) FSEvents-triggered refreshes queue instead of being dropped while one is in flight; (6) if the Claude Code read fails mid-refresh, the already-loaded Codex percentage is preserved instead of flickering away.

title.zh-TW: 更新完畢後，「可更新」標籤懂得乖乖消失
title.en: The "update available" badge cleanly disappears the moment you upgrade

body.zh-TW: 當你升級完這套工具後，選單列上煩人的「🆕 可更新」小標籤終於會自己消失了。以前因為系統只有在跑「檢查更新」那個動作時才會順便清掃狀態，導致你就算已經裝好最新版，那個標籤還是會死皮賴臉地掛在上面，直到你徹底把 App 關掉重開。現在系統每次例行重新整理時都會順便檢查一下你當前安裝的版本，只要發現你已經跟上最新進度，標籤就會立刻退場。就像包裹已經領走了，信箱上的「有掛號信」小紅燈就不會再一直亮著逼你去收信。
body.en: After you upgrade the tool, that nagging "🆕 update available" badge on your menu bar will finally go away on its own. Previously, because the system only swept out the cache while actively checking the internet for new releases, the badge would stubbornly cling to your screen even after you had installed the latest version, forcing you to completely restart the app to clear it. Now, the system double-checks your currently installed version during every routine background tick, and drops the badge the moment it sees you're fully up to date. It's like the "you have mail" light on your mailbox finally knowing to turn off the moment you actually take the package out, instead of glaring at you all day.

items.original: **Stale "🆕 update available" badge no longer lingers after upgrading**: the cache cleanup previously ran only inside the update-check path, so the badge stuck until the app restarted; it now compares the installed version on every timer refresh and clears as soon as you're current.

entries: **Quota usage notifications (opt-in, off by default)**: fires a macOS system notification when usage approaches a threshold, runs out, or recovers ("Almost out / Quota is empty / Quota is back"). Covers both session and weekly quotas for Claude Code and Codex; each threshold alerts once and re-arms after the quota resets. Controlled by one menu toggle; notification text is localized across all five languages in `i18n.json`. Triggered from the existing on-disk usage snapshot — **no network, no API calls**. The packaged `.app` now bundles the UserNotifications framework so alerts are delivered.

**Pace indicator**: the burn-rate warning line ("at current pace, empty in X") now appends whether you're running some multiple faster than your personal average, or under it — so you can tell at a glance if you're burning hotter than usual.

**Ignore echoed Codex quota queries (#23)**: in some cases Codex echoes a prior quota query verbatim; older versions treated these echoes as new messages and let them flood the window. They're now detected and skipped.

title.zh-TW: 額度快用完時，系統會跳通知提醒你
title.en: Desktop notifications alert you when your quota is running low

body.zh-TW: 現在你可以放手工作，不用一直盯著用量看了。只要在選單裡開啟這項功能，當你的 Claude 或 Codex 額度快見底、完全用光、或是重置恢復時，螢幕右上角都會跳出 macOS 系統通知來提醒你。它很克制，每個階段只會提醒一次，不會一直煩你。就像開車時不用死盯著油表，油快沒了儀表板自然會亮燈警告你。
body.en: You can now focus entirely on your work without constantly checking your usage. If you enable this in the menu, a macOS system notification will quietly pop up in the corner of your screen when your Claude or Codex quota is running low, completely empty, or freshly restored. It's respectful of your attention, only nudging you once per threshold so it never spams you. Like driving a car—you don't need to stare at the gas gauge, because a light will pop on automatically when the tank is getting empty.

Covers both session and weekly quotas for Claude Code and Codex; each threshold alerts once and re-arms after the quota resets. Controlled by one menu toggle; notification text is localized across all five languages in `i18n.json`. Triggered from the existing on-disk usage snapshot — **no network, no API calls**. The packaged `.app` now bundles the UserNotifications framework so alerts are delivered.

title.zh-TW: 一眼看出現在燒得比平常快還是省
title.en: See at a glance if you're burning through tokens faster or slower than usual

body.zh-TW: 燃燒警告文字後面，現在多了一個「配速指示器」。這就像開車時油表原本好幾天才會掉一格，現在換成了數位儀表板，每踩一次油門都會告訴你這一秒燒了多少油。這樣你馬上就能判斷，這個飆高的數字只是短暫的波動，還是你平常真的就用這麼兇。
body.en: Right after the burn-rate warning, you'll now see a new "pace indicator". It's like upgrading your car's fuel gauge from a needle that drops once every few days to a digital dash that updates your instant fuel economy every time you tap the pedal. With this, you'll know right away whether the scary estimate is just a temporary spike, or if that's actually your normal pace.

items.original: **Pace indicator**: the burn-rate warning line ("at current pace, empty in X") now appends whether you're running some multiple faster than your personal average, or under it — so you can tell at a glance if you're burning hotter than usual.

title.zh-TW: 畫面不再被無意義的額度查詢訊息洗版
title.en: The screen is no longer flooded with meaningless repeated quota queries

body.zh-TW: 在使用 Codex 時，你的視窗不會再莫名其妙被一堆重複的系統訊息塞滿了。以前在某些情況下，Codex 會像學人精一樣，把你剛剛查額度的動作原封不動拋回來，導致舊版程式誤以為那是新訊息，把它們全部印在畫面上洗版；現在系統懂得辨識並過濾掉這些無意義的回音。就像你對著山谷喊話，現在只會聽到別人真正的回答，不會再被自己的回音吵得無法對話。
body.en: When using Codex, your window will no longer inexplicably fill up with a wall of repeated system messages. Previously, under certain conditions, Codex would echo your underlying quota queries right back at you, which the older version of the app mistook for new messages and dumped onto your screen; the system is now smart enough to recognize and filter out these meaningless echoes. It's like shouting into a canyon—you'll now only hear genuine replies from others, instead of being deafened by your own echoes bouncing back.

items.original: **Ignore echoed Codex quota queries (#23)**: in some cases Codex echoes a prior quota query verbatim; older versions treated these echoes as new messages and let them flood the window. They're now detected and skipped.

entries: **HTML report merges "Your subscription" and "By tool" into "Your tools"**: the two panels used to describe the same Claude Code / Codex tools separately. Now there's one card per tool — the plan badge and subscription start date sit alongside the share / tokens / cost stats under a single shared header, dropping the duplicate block.

**Top KPI cards rebalanced**: the TOKENS column now gets the widest slot so the full number (e.g. `2,364,752,661`) never truncates or overflows at any window width, with `tabular-nums` for cleaner digit alignment.

**README overhaul (EN/繁中)**: privacy / requirements and quick start moved to the top, the three install methods presented on equal footing, feature bullets and punctuation trimmed, and the developer guide moved to `docs/DEVELOPMENT`.

title.zh-TW: 報告畫面更俐落，超長數字不再被切斷
title.en: Report layout gets cleaner and massive numbers stop getting cut off

body.zh-TW: 查看 HTML 報告時，介面變得更清爽易讀了。以前報告裡會把「你的訂閱」跟「工具用量」拆成兩塊講同一件事，現在它們合併成「你的工具」卡片，方案名稱和花費等資訊統整在一起，不用再上下對照。另外，頂部的關鍵指標（KPI）卡片也調整了寬度比例，把最佔空間的 TOKENS 欄位拉寬，確保就算你用了幾十億的 token（AI 處理文字的單位），數字也能完整顯示，不會因為視窗太窄被卡掉一半，而且數字切換時會對齊得像收銀機的螢幕一樣整齊。就像去銀行刷存摺，以前帳戶資訊跟交易明細印在不同頁要翻來翻去，而且金額太大印表機還會印出格子外，現在全部集中在一頁，數字再大也印得清清楚楚。
body.en: The HTML report interface is now much cleaner and easier to read. Previously, the report described the same tools across two separate "Your subscription" and "By tool" sections; they are now merged into a single "Your tools" card where your plan details and cost stats sit together, sparing you the back-and-forth scrolling. Furthermore, the top KPI cards have been rebalanced to give the TOKENS column the widest slot. This ensures that even if you've consumed billions of tokens (the units AI uses to process text), the massive number won't be truncated or pushed out of bounds on narrow windows, and the digits line up as neatly as a cash register display. It's like updating your bank passbook: previously, your account info and transaction history were on different pages, and massive balances would print off the edge of the paper; now it's all cleanly consolidated on one page, and every digit fits perfectly.

**Top KPI cards rebalanced**: the TOKENS column now gets the widest slot so the full number (e.g. `2,364,752,661`) never truncates or overflows at any window width, with `tabular-nums` for cleaner digit alignment.

title.zh-TW: 說明文件大翻新，新手上路不再迷路
title.en: README gets a major overhaul to keep new users from getting lost

body.zh-TW: 第一次安裝這個工具的說明文件（README）變得更友善了。原本落落長的文件經過大幅瘦身，隱私保護承諾、系統需求跟快速上手指南全被移到了最顯眼的開頭，而且三種安裝方式也排在同等重要的位置任你選，不再有主從之分。一些囉唆的功能條列和標點符號被刪減，給開發者看的生硬指南也被移進了專屬的 `docs/DEVELOPMENT` 資料夾裡，不會再干擾一般使用者。就像遊樂園的導覽手冊，以前把逃生路線跟維修人員手冊全混在一起印，遊客找個廁所都要翻半天；現在第一頁就是遊園地圖跟買票指南，維修手冊則另外印給員工看。
body.en: The setup documentation (README) has been made much friendlier for first-time users. The formerly massive document has been significantly trimmed down: privacy promises, system requirements, and the quick start guide are now front and center at the very top. The three different installation methods are now presented on equal footing for you to choose from, rather than burying one under the others. Wordy feature bullets and punctuation have been tightened, and the highly technical developer guide has been safely relocated to its own `docs/DEVELOPMENT` folder so it no longer clutters the experience for regular users. It's like a theme park brochure: they used to print the emergency exits and the mechanic's maintenance manual all mixed in with the attraction list, making tourists flip endlessly just to find a restroom; now the first page is purely the park map and ticketing guide, while the mechanic's manual is printed separately for the staff.

items.original: **README overhaul (EN/繁中)**: privacy / requirements and quick start moved to the top, the three install methods presented on equal footing, feature bullets and punctuation trimmed, and the developer guide moved to `docs/DEVELOPMENT`.

entries: **Codex quota stuck on stale values**: `load_rate_limits()` returned as soon as SQLite (`logs_2.sqlite`) had any data, never comparing the newer `rate_limits` in `~/.codex/sessions/*.jsonl`, so the menu bar stayed pinned to the previous day's quota. It now reads both SQLite and JSONL and picks the newest valid entry by `updated_at`, keeping the prior SQLite-preferred behavior when timestamps are equal.

title.zh-TW: 選單列的額度不再卡住，及時反映最新用量
title.en: The menu bar quota stops getting stuck and correctly reflects your latest usage

body.zh-TW: 你在選單列看到的 Codex（另一款 AI 工具）剩餘額度，現在會準確更新了。以前系統在撈取你的使用進度時，只要在它的一個資料庫（SQLite，一種輕量級資料庫）裡找到舊資料就草草收工，根本不去比對另一邊文字檔裡其實已經有了更新的額度，導致你的選單列總是卡在前一天的進度動也不動。現在系統會同時比對這兩個地方，挑選時間標籤最新的一筆資料來顯示。就像你搬家後已經去郵局更新了通訊地址，但銀行還是一直把你上個月的舊地址印在對帳單上，因為他們只查了最舊的檔案櫃；現在銀行會把兩個櫃子都打開看，誰的日期新就用誰的。
body.en: The remaining Codex (another AI tool) quota shown on your menu bar will now update accurately. Previously, when checking your usage, the system would call it a day the moment it found old data in its primary database (SQLite, a lightweight database format), completely ignoring the fact that fresher quota limits were sitting right there in your text logs. This caused your menu bar to stay stubbornly pinned to yesterday's numbers. The system now cross-references both storage locations and always displays the entry with the most recent timestamp. It's like moving to a new house and updating your address at the post office, but your bank keeps printing your old address on your statements because they only checked their oldest filing cabinet; now, the bank opens both cabinets and uses whichever paper has the newest date on it.

items.original: **Codex quota stuck on stale values**: `load_rate_limits()` returned as soon as SQLite (`logs_2.sqlite`) had any data, never comparing the newer `rate_limits` in `~/.codex/sessions/*.jsonl`, so the menu bar stayed pinned to the previous day's quota. It now reads both SQLite and JSONL and picks the newest valid entry by `updated_at`, keeping the prior SQLite-preferred behavior when timestamps are equal.

entries: **"Usage Habits" section in the HTML report**: fully local, zero API. The analysis report now shows a full-width 24-hour activity histogram of when you work, highlighting your peak hour with a plain-language summary ("You most often work with AI around HH:00 and HH:00"). Data comes from the message timestamps in your local Claude Code logs (user / assistant messages only) — **never the conversation content**. Parsing lives in a standalone `persona_loader.py` with a 300s TTL cache.

**"Stale data" hint on the Codex card**: when the local Codex usage snapshot is older than 15 minutes, the classic panel's Codex card shows an "about N minutes ago" tag plus an info (ⓘ) tooltip. Unlike Claude Code, Codex has no live status-line hook, so its usage numbers come from session logs it writes only intermittently and can lag your real account; the tooltip also explains that staying offline is a deliberate choice so it never burns your tokens. Built from the existing `rate_limits.updated_at` — **no network, no API**.

title.zh-TW: 報表畫出你一整天什麼時段最常找 AI，而且不偷看內容
title.en: The report charts when you reach for AI most across your day, without peeking at content

body.zh-TW: 想知道自己一天到底都在什麼時段用 AI，現在報表會直接畫給你看。分析報表新增了「Usage Habits（使用習慣）」段落，把一整天 24 小時的活動量畫成一條橫跨整個畫面的直方圖（histogram，一種用高低柱子表示數量多寡的長條圖），並標出你的尖峰時段，旁邊附一句白話摘要，像是「你最常在 HH:00 和 HH:00 這兩個時間點找 AI」。這份資料完全來自你本地 Claude Code 紀錄檔裡訊息的時間戳（timestamp，像 2026-07-14 14:30 這種標記訊息發送時刻的字串），而且只看使用者與 AI 助理訊息的時間點——**絕不碰對話內容**，你們聊了什麼完全不會被讀取。整個功能跑在你自己電腦上，不送任何資料到雲端、不呼叫任何 API。就像一個只看打卡時間、絕不偷瞄你電腦螢幕的書記，幫你整理出你最常在哪些時段上工。
body.en: Want to know which hours of the day you actually lean on AI? The report now charts it directly. The analysis report gained a new "Usage Habits" section that plots a full-width, 24-hour activity histogram (a chart of high and low bars showing how much activity falls in each slot), highlights your peak hour, and prints a plain-language summary beside it like "You most often work with AI around HH:00 and HH:00". The data comes entirely from the message timestamps (strings marking when each message was sent, like 2026-07-14 14:30) in your local Claude Code logs, looking only at the timing of user and assistant messages — **never the conversation content**; what you actually discussed is never read. The whole feature runs on your own machine, sending nothing to the cloud and calling no API. It's like a clerk who watches only the clock when you badge in and never glances at your screen, summing up which hours you work most.

items.original: **"Usage Habits" section in the HTML report**: fully local, zero API. The analysis report now shows a full-width 24-hour activity histogram of when you work, highlighting your peak hour with a plain-language summary ("You most often work with AI around HH:00 and HH:00"). Data comes from the message timestamps in your local Claude Code logs (user / assistant messages only) — **never the conversation content**. Parsing lives in a standalone `persona_loader.py` with a 300s TTL cache.

title.zh-TW: Codex 數字太舊時面板會誠實標「N 分鐘前」，不讓你白等
title.en: When Codex's number goes stale, the panel honestly flags it "N minutes ago" so you don't wait in vain

body.zh-TW: 現在當 Codex 的數字比較舊時，面板會直接告訴你「這是約 N 分鐘前的」，而不是讓你對著過時數字乾著急。Classic 面板的 Codex 卡片，當本地用量快照（snapshot，某個時間點拍下的資料定格照）超過 15 分鐘沒更新，就會顯示一個「about N minutes ago（約 N 分鐘前）」標籤，外加一個 ⓘ 資訊圖示的提示框（tooltip，滑鼠移上去才彈出的小說明）。為什麼會落後？因為跟 Claude Code 不同，Codex 沒有即時的狀態列掛鉤（status-line hook，一種讓程式把最新狀態即時塞進選單列的接掛點），它的用量數字只能靠它自己間歇寫進紀錄檔的工作階段（session）資料，自然會比你真實帳戶慢半拍。那個提示框也會說清楚：刻意保持離線、不上線查詢是設計選擇，為的就是絕不消耗你的 token（AI 計量的單位，回答越長花越多）。而這整個提示只用既有的 `rate_limits.updated_at` 欄位就能算出來——不用連網、不用 API。就像油耗表上如果數字是早上加油時記的，現在會貼一張「約 3 小時前」的便條提醒你別太相信，並附上說明：這台車刻意不連線回報，是為了不花你的通訊費。
body.en: When Codex's number goes stale, the panel now tells you straight up "this is about N minutes old" instead of leaving you staring at an outdated figure. On the classic panel's Codex card, once the local usage snapshot (a frozen data snapshot taken at one point in time) is older than 15 minutes, an "about N minutes ago" tag appears along with an ⓘ info tooltip (a small explanation that pops up when you hover). Why does it lag? Unlike Claude Code, Codex has no live status-line hook (a hookup point that lets a program push its latest state into the menu bar in real time), so its usage figures can only come from the session data it writes into its logs intermittently, naturally trailing your real account. The tooltip also explains that staying deliberately offline — not querying online — is a design choice so it never burns your token (the unit AI usage is metered in; longer answers cost more). And this entire hint is computed from the existing `rate_limits.updated_at` field — no network, no API. It's like a fuel gauge whose reading was taken at the morning fill-up now wearing a sticky note saying "about 3 hours ago" so you don't trust it blindly, with an attached note explaining: this car deliberately doesn't report in remotely, so it won't rack up your data charges.

items.original: **"Stale data" hint on the Codex card**: when the local Codex usage snapshot is older than 15 minutes, the classic panel's Codex card shows an "about N minutes ago" tag plus an info (ⓘ) tooltip. Unlike Claude Code, Codex has no live status-line hook, so its usage numbers come from session logs it writes only intermittently and can lag your real account; the tooltip also explains that staying offline is a deliberate choice so it never burns your tokens. Built from the existing `rate_limits.updated_at` — **no network, no API**.

entries: **"Progress Concierge" feature** (menu label: "Resume Last Session"): fully local, zero API. When you open a new Claude Code session (`startup` / `/clear`), it automatically hands your last progress to the AI — no need to re-explain. title.zh-TW: 換上專屬圖示，還能自動幫你接續上次的對話
title.en: New app icon arrives, and the Concierge automatically resumes your last session

body.zh-TW: 開啟 App 時，你不再看到公版的火箭圖案，而是專屬的品牌圖示，而且它還學會了超強的「進度管家」功能。以前你每次開啟新的 Claude Code 對話（例如啟動或輸入 `/clear` 指令）時，都要苦命地跟 AI 重新交代「我上次做到哪裡、我接下來要幹嘛」；現在只要在選單列打開「接著上次做」開關，它會自動把你前一次的最後要求、寫完的程式碼紀錄（commit）和未完成的待辦事項打包，趁新對話一開始偷偷塞給 AI，並讓 AI 跟你打招呼說「🐾 已接回上次進度，繼續吧！」。同時，原本選單裡佔掉一大片版面的 9 個面板主題，現在整齊地收進了「面板主題」子選單裡，不再滑不到底了。就像去髮廊，以前每次都要跟新來的設計師重新解釋你要剪什麼髮型，現在櫃檯管家會先把你的修剪紀錄跟未完成的染髮卡交給設計師，你一坐下他就會說「我們繼續上次的進度吧」；而這家髮廊的招牌也終於從公版圖案換成了自家的專屬 Logo。
body.en: When launching the app, you'll see a dedicated brand icon instead of the generic rocket, and it now comes with an incredibly handy "Progress Concierge". Previously, whenever you started a new Claude Code session (like launching or typing `/clear`), you had to painstakingly re-explain to the AI where you left off and what your next goal was. Now, if you toggle on "Resume Last Session" in the menu, it automatically bundles your last request, recent commits, and unfinished to-dos, then quietly hands them to the AI as the new session opens. The AI will even greet you with "🐾 Picked up where you left off — let's keep going!" so you know it worked. In addition, the long list of 9 panel themes that used to hog the menu has been neatly tucked into a "Panel theme" submenu. It's like going to a hair salon: you used to have to re-explain your desired haircut to a new stylist every time, but now the receptionist hands your styling history and pending coloring notes to the stylist before you even sit down, and they just say "Let's continue where we left off"; plus, the salon finally replaced its generic stock-image sign with a proper custom logo.

title.zh-TW: 嚴密防堵壞檔案，面板載入不再意外死當
title.en: Bad files are blocked securely, and the panel loads without unexpected crashes

body.zh-TW: 讀取本機資料時變得更「耐摔」了。以前只要你的硬碟裡躺著一兩個亂碼檔（壞掉的 UTF-8 編碼）、格式爛掉的設定檔（壞 JSON）或是原本該是文字卻變成數字的詭異欄位，一讀進去就會當場嚇到死當；現在所有「讀檔入口」都加上了防護，遇到這種壞檔案會冷靜過濾掉，不會讓整個程式崩潰。另外，在載入 WebKit 面板的備用路線（loadBundle fallback）上，原本漏註冊了 evaluateJavaScript 需要的 block 簽名（signature），導致面板可能一片空白，現在也把它補上了。就像資源回收場的機器，以前不小心吞進一塊石頭整台機器就卡死冒煙，現在裝了強大的過濾網，不是鐵鋁罐的東西都會被自動彈開，機器依然順暢運轉。
body.en: Reading your local data is now much more "drop-proof". Previously, if your hard drive contained a few garbled files (bad UTF-8 encodings), corrupted configurations (bad JSON), or weird fields where numbers appeared instead of text, reading them would immediately panic and crash the application. Every single "file reading entry point" is now armored: when it encounters these toxic files, it calmly filters them out instead of bringing down the whole app. Additionally, on the WebKit panel's fallback loading route (loadBundle), the missing block signature for evaluateJavaScript has been registered to prevent the screen from rendering completely blank. It's like a recycling plant sorting machine: it used to jam and catch fire if it accidentally swallowed a rock, but now it has a heavy-duty filter that automatically bounces out anything that isn't an aluminum can, letting the machine hum along uninterrupted.

items.original:
**Broad robustness hardening**: systematically hardened every entry point that reads user files on disk against bad UTF-8, bad JSON, and type drift (numeric strings, non-dict, non-str fields) — covering `setup_hook`, `codex_loader`, the Codex / Claude / rate-limit adapters, the statusline, the history loader, subscription reads and JWT decoding, and the tips loader.
**WebKit panel fallback**: registered the missing `evaluateJavaScript` block signature on the `loadBundle` fallback path.

entries: **File-level cache for the HTML report loaders**: `adapters/claude.py` and `adapters/codex.py` gain an `mtime`+`size`-keyed LRU cache (matching `history_loader`), so generating a report no longer re-parses every JSONL log on each run; the Codex adapter shares one cache between `load_entries` and `load_rate_limits`. Whole-file `OSError` / `PermissionError` / `sqlite3.Error` are now printed to stderr when `USAGE_DEBUG=1` (per-line `JSONDecodeError` stays silent).

**mypy `--strict` now covers the whole codebase**: removed the mypy exclude for `adapters/`, `analyzer/`, `ui/` and `usage_cli.py` (a ~35% type-checking blind spot), added the missing generics and function annotations, and switched `_group_by_agent` to a PEP 695 type parameter. `mypy --strict` now checks all 70 source files.

**Three cross-module functions in `adapters/claude.py` are now public API**: `get_claude_dirs`, `extract_project_from_dir`, `parse_jsonl` (previously underscore-private), dropping the matching `# type: ignore[attr-defined]` in `analyzer/reporter.py`.

Removing the mypy exclude surfaced and fixed a few latent issues: a redundant `parsed_entries` re-annotation left over from the cache change in `adapters/claude.py`, the `agent` loop variable reused with two different types in `analyzer/reporter.py` (inner accumulator renamed `agent_totals`), and a redundant `cast` in `menubar.py`.
Added coverage for `_apply_sort` with the `"time"` sort key (which maps to `None` and is handled per-command).
Added an i18n key-parity test asserting all five `i18n.json` language sections share the same key set, so a forgotten translation fails CI instead of silently falling back to English.

title.zh-TW: 產出報告不再龜速，底層抓蟲大掃除
title.en: Report generation speeds up, and deep bugs get swept away

body.zh-TW: 現在你點擊產出 HTML 分析報告時，速度會快上很多。以前系統很笨，每次產報告都會把你的所有歷史紀錄檔從頭到尾重新讀一遍；現在它學會了「快取（cache，把讀過的資料暫存在記憶體裡）」，只要檔案沒被改過，它就會直接拿上次記住的結果來用。同時，我們對系統底層進行了大規模的「型別檢查（type-checking，確保每個變數都裝對東西的健康檢查）」，原本有 35% 的程式碼是檢查死角，現在全面覆蓋後，順手抓出了好幾個隱藏的變數錯用和重複設定問題。我們還加上了多國語系的自動防呆測試，以後只要有一國語言漏翻譯，系統在出廠前就會自動擋下，不會再發生切成日文卻默默跑出英文的怪事。就像圖書館員以前每次有人問庫存，都要把整座圖書館的書重新數一遍，現在他終於學會看庫存登記簿了；而且圖書館還趁機做了一次全棟安檢，把以前偷懶沒巡到的黑暗死角全掃了一遍，連標示牌翻譯漏字的瑕疵都抓出來了。
body.en: Generating your HTML analysis reports is now significantly faster. Previously, the system was stubbornly inefficient, re-reading every single one of your historical log files from scratch every time you asked for a report. It now employs caching (saving previously read data into memory): if a file hasn't changed, it instantly reuses what it already remembers. Meanwhile, we've subjected the system's foundation to a massive type-checking sweep (a health check ensuring every variable holds the right kind of data). We uncovered a 35% blind spot in the codebase, and by covering it, we swept out several latent bugs involving mixed-up variables and redundant settings. We also added an automated failsafe for translations, meaning if a single word is left untranslated in any language, the build will immediately fail before release, stopping the weird glitch where a Japanese menu would silently fall back to English. It's like a librarian who used to recount every single book in the building whenever you asked for inventory, but has finally learned to just read the ledger. Plus, the library just passed a full-building safety inspection that shined a light into all the neglected dark corners, fixing even the missing translations on the exit signs.

entries: **"Your subscription" section in the HTML report**: auto-detects Claude (plan + subscription start date) and Codex (ChatGPT plan + subscription start date) from the local OAuth account files. Only the plan name and start date are read — tokens, emails and other secrets are never touched. When sharing the report, the subscription date is masked together with the "Hide project names" toggle. Adds the `subscription.py` module and its tests.

**Project-share donut chart in the HTML report**: pure-SVG (zero external deps) breakdown of token share per project; the top 6 projects get their own colour, the rest fold into "Other", and the centre shows the total.
**"Claude vs Codex" comparison section in the HTML report**: surfaces the per-agent usage (tokens / share / cost) that `build_report_data` already computed but never displayed.

**Double-counted report cost**: `build_report_data` summed cost once over all entries and then recomputed it per entry inside the loop — effectively doubling the work on large datasets. Now accumulated once inside the loop.
**Duplicated clipboard code in the report's "copy command" button**: the tip-copy button now reuses the shared `copyText()` helper instead of re-implementing the legacy-browser fallback.
**Hard-coded TWD rate**: the USD→TWD estimate in the report is now a named `_USD_TO_TWD` constant with a note that it is a display estimate, not a live FX rate.

title.zh-TW: 報告大升級：幫你抓出訂閱方案，新增專案圓環圖
title.en: Report upgrades: auto-detecting subscriptions and a new project donut chart

body.zh-TW: HTML 分析報告現在會顯示更多有用的資訊。它新增了「你的訂閱」區塊，會自動從你電腦裡的授權檔讀出你買的是哪種 Claude 方案或 Codex 的 ChatGPT 方案，以及訂閱開始日期（放心，它絕不會偷看你的密碼或 email），而且當你把報告分享給別人並開啟「隱藏專案名稱」時，訂閱日也會自動幫你打上馬賽克。報告裡還多了一張精美的「專案佔比圓環圖」，把最吃資源的前 6 大專案塗上不同顏色，剩下的歸類為「其他」，正中央大字寫著總用量，一目了然。此外，以前系統其實早就默默算好了 Claude 跟 Codex 兩邊的用量對決（花了多少 token、佔比與成本），現在這份「Claude vs Codex」的對比戰報終於解禁顯示出來了。就像你去體檢，以前只給你一張總結數字，現在不僅在開頭幫你印出你買的是哪種等級的健檢套餐，還附上精緻的彩色圓餅圖告訴你哪裡脂肪最多，甚至把你兩隻手的肌肉量拉出來做對比。
body.en: The HTML analysis report now displays a wealth of new insights. It introduces a "Your subscription" section that automatically detects which Claude tier or Codex ChatGPT plan you're paying for and when the subscription started, directly from your local authorization files (rest assured, it strictly ignores your passwords and emails). If you share the report and toggle "Hide project names", the subscription date gets pixelated out for privacy too. There is also a beautiful new "Project-share donut chart" that breaks down your usage, assigning unique colors to your top 6 hungriest projects, folding the rest into "Other", and boldly stamping the total in the center. Furthermore, the system had secretly been calculating the usage duel between Claude and Codex (how many tokens, share, and cost each consumed), and this "Claude vs Codex" head-to-head comparison is now finally visible. It's like getting a medical checkup: they used to just hand you a single total score, but now the report spells out exactly which premium health package you bought, gives you a vivid color chart of exactly where you're storing the most fat, and even explicitly compares the muscle mass of your left arm versus your right.

title.zh-TW: 整理底層管線，除錯也不再讓電腦做白工
title.en: Internal pipelines polished, saving your computer from doing double duty

body.zh-TW: 產出報告的速度變得更快，因為系統改掉了背後的愚蠢計算方式。在計算報告的花費時，系統以前很糊塗，會先把所有數字加總一次，然後又在小圈圈裡一筆一筆重新算，如果你的資料量很大，它等於是在做雙倍的白工；現在改為只在小圈圈裡算一次，速度順暢多了。另外，報告裡「複製指令」按鈕的程式碼也被清理過了，不再疊床架屋寫兩份一樣的複製邏輯；而報告裡用來估算的台幣匯率，也標上了清楚的內部註解，說明這只是個固定的預估值、不是即時連網抓的匯率。就像餐廳的結帳櫃檯，以前算帳時會先把所有菜單全拿出來用計算機按一次，然後又翻開點菜單一筆一筆再加一次，客人排隊排到天荒地老；現在收銀員變聰明了，一邊點菜一邊就算好總金額。而且點餐機裡的程式碼也整理過了，上面還貼了張便條紙提醒新來的員工「這裡的匯率是寫死的參考值，不要傻傻去對當天的新聞」。
body.en: Your reports now generate faster because the system dropped some silly internal calculation habits. When calculating your report costs, the system used to be deeply confused: it would sum up all the numbers once, and then redundantly re-calculate everything piece by piece inside a loop. If you had massive amounts of data, it was effectively doing double the work for nothing; it now smartly accumulates the total in a single pass, saving processing time. We also cleaned up the clipboard code for the "copy command" buttons in the report so it no longer relies on two duplicated chunks of logic, and we added a clear internal note to the hard-coded TWD exchange rate explaining it's just a static display estimate rather than a live network fetch. It's like a restaurant checkout counter: the cashier used to punch every single receipt into the calculator once, and then painstakingly re-add every itemized dish again while the line grew out the door; now they simply tally the total in one smooth motion. The cash register's software is much cleaner now, too, sporting a sticky note that reminds the new hires, "The exchange rate here is just an estimate, don't try matching it against the morning news."

items.original:
**Double-counted report cost**: `build_report_data` summed cost once over all entries and then recomputed it per entry inside the loop — effectively doubling the work on large datasets. Now accumulated once inside the loop.
**Duplicated clipboard code in the report's "copy command" button**: the tip-copy button now reuses the shared `copyText()` helper instead of re-implementing the legacy-browser fallback.
**Hard-coded TWD rate**: the USD→TWD estimate in the report is now a named `_USD_TO_TWD` constant with a note that it is a display estimate, not a live FX rate.

entries: **"Hide Codex Section" menu toggle**: the menubar gained a "Hide Codex Section" option that collapses the Codex card across all 9 HTML panels and shrinks popover height per-panel. The preference persists via `NSUserDefaults` so it survives restarts. i18n keys added for all 5 locales. (PR #19, thanks @RayCHWong for the first-time contribution)

**`HTMLPanel.codex_card_height` is now a required keyword-only argument with no default**: previously the parameter had a `192.0` default, so a new panel that forgot to set its height in `panels/__init__.py` would silently fall back to the default — the Codex card would render at a height that doesn't match the rest of the panel without raising any error. Now declared as `*, codex_card_height: float` (keyword-only, no default), so any missing call site raises `TypeError` at import. All 9 existing panels already pass it by keyword and are unaffected; added `test_html_panel_requires_explicit_codex_card_height` to lock the contract.

title.zh-TW: 新增「隱藏 Codex 區塊」開關，不用 Codex 也能讓面板保持清爽
title.en: Hide the Codex section for a cleaner panel if you don't use it

body.zh-TW: 你現在可以在選單列裡找到一個「隱藏 Codex 區塊」的新選項。如果你平常只用 Claude 而不用 Codex，只要打開這個選項，所有 9 款 HTML 面板裡的 Codex 卡片就會全部收起來，彈出視窗（popover）的高度也會自動跟著縮減，幫你省下寶貴的螢幕空間。這個設定會被系統記住，重新開機也不用重調。對於想要自己新增面板的開發者，我們也加強了防呆機制——現在在程式碼裡強制規定必須明確指定 Codex 卡片的高度，如果忘了寫，系統在載入時就會立刻報錯提醒，而不是像以前一樣默默套用預設高度而導致版面錯位。這就像是買便當不吃配菜可以勾選「不要配菜」來換取更小的餐盒；同時廚房的點餐系統也加了防呆，沒填包裝盒尺寸的訂單直接退回，再也不會出現大便當裝小菜的尷尬情況。
body.en: You can now find a new "Hide Codex Section" toggle in the menubar. If you only use Claude and not Codex, checking this option will instantly collapse the Codex cards across all 9 HTML panels and automatically shrink the popover windows to match, saving you valuable screen real estate. This preference is saved automatically, so it stays exactly as you left it even after a restart. For developers building new custom panels, we've also added a strict safeguard—the codebase now explicitly requires you to specify the Codex card height. If you forget, it will immediately throw an error at load time instead of silently falling back to a default height that misaligns your layout. It's like ordering a bento box and ticking "no side dishes" so they give you a more compact box; meanwhile, the kitchen's ordering system was upgraded to reject tickets with missing box sizes, preventing tiny sides from awkwardly floating in a massive container.

title.zh-TW: 狀態列進度條換上新裝，一眼看懂額度緊不緊
title.en: Statusline progress bar gets a visual refresh for at-a-glance readability

body.zh-TW: 終端機狀態列上的進度條現在變得更醒目了。以前的進度條是用普通的 ANSI 綠、黃、紅，現在換成了對比更強的 256 色青綠、暖橘和暗紅，而且格子符號也換成了更清晰的「■□」（實心／空心方塊）。現在你只要瞄一眼，就能立刻分辨目前的額度用量是處於安全、警告還是危險狀態。這就像是把原本黯淡的紅綠燈換成了高亮度的 LED 號誌，大老遠就能看清要不要踩煞車。另外，我們也順便把說明文件裡的繁體中文面板截圖換成了包含近期介面改動的最新版本。
body.en: The progress bar on the terminal statusline is now much easier to read. We've switched the characters to clearer solid and hollow squares ("■□"), and moved from standard ANSI colors to a high-contrast 256-color palette (teal, orange, and dark red). Now, you can instantly tell if your usage is in a safe, warning, or danger state with just a quick glance. It's like upgrading a dim traffic light to ultra-bright LEDs—you know exactly when to hit the brakes from a mile away. We've also updated the Traditional Chinese panel screenshot in the documentation to reflect the latest UI changes.

items.original:
**Statusline progress bar visual refresh**: progress bar characters switched from `█░` to `■□` (filled / hollow squares), and the color palette moved from standard ANSI green/yellow/red (32/33/31) to 256-color teal/orange/dark-red (42/214/160) for stronger contrast around the 50% threshold — safe / warning / danger states are now distinguishable at a glance. Changes confined to `usage_statusline.py` (`progress_bar()` and `color_by_pct()`); HTML reports and the TUI progress bars are unaffected.
**Traditional Chinese default panel screenshot refreshed**: `docs/繁體中文面板.png` updated to reflect the latest UI (new "Report / Terminal" toggle, per-project cost display, footer attribution).
